thread:
emma: Heads-up — Cedarwood wants a short POC playbook: models we'll serve, rough cost, security answers, and timeline. EOD tomorrow.

client_pm: Use case: customer-ticket triage + summaries. Expect 8-12 rps, ~1.8k token sessions. P95 target ~220ms. Data includes emails/order IDs — need PII redaction + KMS. Hosted ok for pilot.

ryan: Quick clarifying Qs: hosted acceptable? Any residency constraints?

client_pm: Hosted OK for pilot. Keys/logs must be US-only. SOC2 required. May ask for VPC later.

claire: Noted KMS + SOC2. We'll supply a one-pager: SOC2 attestation, KMS integrations (AWS/GCP envelope), logging, retention, and redaction guidance.

alex: Infra note: to meet P95~220ms at 10 rps with ~2k tokens, keep low-latency batch sizes small (2-4). Recommend two variants: open-13b-fp16 for low-latency hosted route; open-13b-quant-4bit for throughput/dedicated. KV cache for repeated context. VPC transition ~2-3 weeks.

ryan: Draft ops playbook bullets:
- Discovery (owner: emma): confirm throughput, PII scope, key residency
- Sec review (owner: claire + liz): KMS controls, SOC2 evidence, questionnaire
- Arch (owner: alex + ryan): hosted vs dedicated, model variants, cache & batching
- Cost sizing (owner: ryan): token estimates + variant mix + commit tiers
- Pilot (owner: ryan + alex): 2-week pilot with traffic replay
- Handoff (owner: emma + liz): SLA + KMS addendum

ryan: Pilot config (sketch):
```
routes:
  - low_latency: open-13b-fp16, batch=3, max_seq=2048
  - high_throughput: open-13b-quant-4bit, batch=28, kv_cache=true
fallback: prefer_fp16_then_quant
estimate: "fp16 ~$3.0/token-unit; quant ~$0.8/token-unit (very rough)"
```

claire: I'll attach the security one-pager + short answers to the questionnaire (KMS flow, log retention, SOC2). Liz — any legal notes for KMS addendum?

liz: I'll draft a KMS addendum and DPA clause for US-only residency + audit rights. Will flag subprocessors.

emma: Pricing ask from client — they want commit options. Ryan, can you produce: trial (metered), monthly reserved, 12mo commit with dedicated option? Include breakeven examples.

ryan: Yep — will produce 3-tier estimate + run-rate table.

alex: Ops blockers to call out: KMS onboarding (1-2 weeks), VPC networking (2-3 weeks), latency requirement increases cost due to low batching.

client_pm: Good list. Any customer work required pre-pilot?

ryan: For hosted: KMS key setup + test, sample data for redaction tests. For VPC/dedicated later: peering, firewall rules, and KMS access tests. We'll provide a checklist.

emma: Action items for EOD tomorrow:
- ryan: cost tiers, pilot config, timeline (deliverable)
- claire: security one-pager + questionnaire answers (deliverable)
- liz: KMS addendum draft (deliverable)
- alex: infra note on latency tradeoffs + checklist (deliverable)
- emma: compile playbook PDF and send to client

sync-bot: Playbook ticket created: https://redwood.internal/tasks/1798123456 :white_check_mark:

client_pm: Thanks — we'll review once you send. Happy to hop on a short sync after.

emma: I'll book 20-30m after doc upload. Thanks all :pray:
